entry.title: New: visual-review
entry.summary: Renders pasted/uploaded images inline in the DSH Web chat and gives text-only models vision: the model-invokable visual_review tool calls any OpenAI-compatible multimodal API first, falling back to a local Qwen3-VL worker. Exact install spec: visual-review. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
